slides.title: 5 ways to get from Laval to Montreal
slides.sub: Metro, REM, train or bridge: your sector shapes your commute.

photo.credit: Photo: Guilhem Vellut from Annecy, France, CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons

slides.title: Three metro stops on the orange line

photo.credit: Photo: Quebecguy, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons

slides.body: **Cartier** in Pont-Viau, plus **De la Concorde** and **Montmorency** in Laval-des-Rapides. Straight into Montreal on the orange line.

slides.title: Sainte-Dorothée now has the REM

photo.credit: Photo: Quebecguy, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons

slides.body: **Sainte-Dorothée** and **Île-Bigras** REM stations opened Nov. 17, 2025, linking west Laval to downtown Montreal.
slides.source: Per STL and Time Out Montréal, October 2026

slides.title: Commuter train from Sainte-Rose and Vimont
slides.body: The **exo2 Saint-Jérôme** line stops at three Laval stations on its way downtown. Check exo's schedule first.

slides.title: Driving? Your sector picks your bridge
slides.body: Seven road bridges cross the **Rivière des Prairies**. Living near yours makes the daily drive simpler.
